summary: Criteria cover R1-R6 one-to-one and every Target resolves, but two findings block: once Argo has seen the commit, the roll wait has no bound, so an app whose health stays Progressing (e.g. dnsmasq-prd's StatefulSet) holds the tracker forever, which the operator should rule on; and the settled 'Done' ruling checks the compared revision, which P4 disproves in a later bullet instead of the ruling being edited.
